sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Stitches in right temple. Inability to con-
centrate mind.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Pains in abdomen, hepatic region and of
transverse colon, also in gall-bladder and right in-
guinal region and spermatic cords.

Ebetremities. — Shooting pain in back of both wrist
joints. Wrist drops. Pain in right popliteal space
down leg, which feels paralyzed.
